Package me.itzloghotxd.pdk.gui.inventory

package me.itzloghotxd.pdk.gui.inventory
Provides a custom GUI framework for Bukkit and Spigot plugins.

This package contains classes for creating, managing, and handling interactions within custom inventories. It includes:

  • AbstractInventory - Base structure for building custom GUI implementations.
  • InventoryListener - Listener that handles and delegates inventory events.

Custom GUIs are built by extending AbstractInventory, which manages item placement and state. Interactivity is driven by the InventoryListener, which must be registered by the plugin to catch and route inventory events to their respective menus.
